integrity: Classical Dirichlet-multinomial laws are credited; numerical checks corroborate but do not replace the analytic proof. No independent scientific validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed total Dirichlet concentration; eventual global one-crossing proved only for 0<gamma<1 and sufficiently many species. For gamma>=1 only mesoscopic negative covariance is asserted; independently audited novelty not claimed. Full 2005 publication was not inspected.
title: A square-root singleton–doubleton covariance transition in finite Dirichlet populations
